title: Welded tube truss
summary: coped tubes, weld beads, coping template
description: An original 6 m Warren truss of EN 10219-2 circular hollow sections in S355J2H, with gap K-joints to EN 1993-1-8, coped diagonals fillet-welded all round and end plates, in red-oxide primer.
process: Tube profile cutting, MAG welding (ISO 4063 process 135), red-oxide shop primer

difficulty.rationale: Simple cylinders, but the diagonals' angle solved in closed form from coupled formulas, weld beads made by a chamfer on a union, a coped tube unfolded to a 1:1 template, EN 1993-1-8 checks across several bodies, and three kernel limits worked around.

prompt_test.model: Claude Sonnet 5.5, medium effort, through craft3d-cli
prompt_test.result: Passed: diagonals at 50.93°, 28.0 mm gaps, 7.93 mm eccentricity, chords 6228.6 and 5297.6 mm, 247.55 kg of members and 2.243 kg of weld, as this example's; its 36 assertions pass at the other section pairs. It read the diagonal's cut length as the square-cut 674.6 mm, which exposed the README's 647.8 mm as the mitred length only; turn 5 now asks for both. About 216 steps.
